references.text: The same introductory formula, "The Lord spoke to Moses," is used when God gives instructions about the covenant at Sinai.
Identical introductory formula where the Lord speaks to Moses to give legislation.
The opening formula in Leviticus that establishes the pattern for divine revelation to Moses.
The same standard formula that introduces new sections with divine instructions in Leviticus.
Parallel introductory formula marking the beginning of purity laws.
The same formula is used to introduce Numbers, where the Lord speaks to Moses.
Repetition of the formula showing the continuity of God's communication with Moses.
